title: Count in 2s, 5s and 10s
summary: Count in fives, continue a count, find a missing number and count groups.
subject: maths

difficultyRamp.within: Q1 counts 15 blocks in fives on a ten frame. Child thinks 5, 10, 15. Q2 continues 5, 10, 15. Q3 finds 15 in a fives gap. Q4 counts groups of 5 in 20 blocks. Q5 fills 45 on a hundred square counting in fives. Q6 lands on 15 after jumps of 5. Q7 matches 20 to a fives count. Q8 picks two fives-count numbers. Q9 counts 3 children holding up one hand each. Q10 orders 5, 10, 15, 20.
difficultyRamp.versus: Easy uses pairs and tens pictures up to 50. Medium introduces fives, continuing a count, a missing 5s number and counting groups. Hard mixes steps, counts back, spots a number you would not say, uses a number line with no objects, and a short hands story. Hard is a new kind of thinking, not just bigger numbers.
